Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:

Reheat Turbine 
 Tandem Compound
 Double Flow
Westinghouse
Issued to: Shoubra Elkhimah PS
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I2 to be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block.
The technical specification of the turbine:

Units SN:13A6501 
(unit 1), 13A6531 (unit 2), 
13A6541 (unit 3), 23A6731 (unit 4)

This 
unit is a two cylinder tandem compound double exhaust, condensing reheat 
turbine, designed for high operating efficiencies.

The first draft initiated by eng.
Tarek Abd Elmonem Mahmoud, revised
by eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Shaker, approved by eng. Mohamed Helmy Habib general 
director, accepted by eng. Mohamed El-tahawy Mostafa Head sector of Shoubra
El-Khimah PS 4x315MW.

This document certified by eng. 
Afaf Ebrahim Eldib CEPC inspection and quality control head sector MPIS 
Coordinator and reviewed by eng. Nageh Soliman Shoosha .
Safety Precaution

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker for
electrical equipments

items:
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker for
electrical equipments

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be carried out

Check all drain lines and V/Vs
from the turbine and the isolated piping.

Check all orifices and traps by
measuring the pipe temperature upstream and down stream.

Internal inspection, 
cleaning, and
maintain of one valve from each turbine critical valves types, if any problem
detected, check all valves of the type.

Grease governor end pedestal,
onboard cylinder supports and sole plate, grease cylinder outer supports and
seating plate.

Grease all steam threads on manual
V/Vs.
